notes.title: Steam Patch 1.1.4
notes.notes:
Kind of a hot fix for some breaks for both PC and Mac:
L3 - Balls now drop on repeat play
L5 - Large ball reset issue solved
L12 - Saving issues solved, and crystal unlocks now firing

Thanks for the patience everyone!

notes.title: Dev plays with his Mum
notes.notes: It took me 7 years to make this game, and my Mum has been patiently waiting to have a play. Mind you she doesn't really play games, so let's see how this goes.

notes.title: The Master's Pupil Demo Playthrough
notes.notes: To celebrate Next Fest, The Lyrical plays through The Master's Pupil Demo! Join us and chat to developer Pat Naoum to discuss solo development, hand-painting a game, and all thing's The Master's Pupil.
